Step: The sum of the residuals is $$0$$.

Hint 1: Recall that in an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression model, the sum of the residuals is always zero when an intercept is included in the model. This is a fundamental property of OLS.

Hint 2: Consider the fact that the residuals represent the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. The OLS method minimizes the sum of squared residuals, and with an intercept, this results in the sum of the residuals being zero.
